structuralFindings: Base meal plan is Bed & Breakfast (explicitly stated in document header) — a genuinely different base than Chale Island's Half Board, even though these two properties are commercially bundled/sold together.

4 room categories: Sea Breeze Room, Ocean View Suite, Beach Cottage (all max 3 pax, per-person-sharing shape identical to Chale Island's), plus Family Suite which is priced 'Based on min 4 pax sharing' as a flat figure with a separate 'Extra bed' add-on — a 4th, differently-shaped category not present at Chale Island.
Same 3 season bands as Chale Island (Spring 15Mar-15Jun, Regular implicit, Festive 20Dec-10Jan min 7 nights) — confirmed identical wording, a shared complex-wide season calendar.
Supplement structure simpler than Chale Island: only Half Board and Full Board supplements exist (no All Inclusive supplement line), consistent with there being no AI-inclusive room category here.
